valuation.method: Forward non-GAAP EPS x justified P/E, with the earnings base viewed at the 12-month target date (about Nov 2027). Only sourced earnings figure: FY27 (year ending Jan 2027) non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance of $25.50, raised from $17.90 with the Q2 FY27 report on 2026-09-01 (SEC 8-K). Dell gave no FY28 outlook, so the FY28 EPS used in each case is a model assumption, not company guidance. Listing is USD on NYSE, so no FX conversion applies. Scenario targets are per share of the USD listing.

bear.driver: AI server margin compression and memory/component supply constraints (TD Cowen flagged memory constraints as a risk to 2027 upside) cut EPS growth sharply; the stock de-rates to a hardware-multiple range
bear.assumption: FY28 EPS $20.00 (about 22% below the FY27 guide) at 13x

base.driver: AI server backlog (record $95B at Jul 31, 2026) converts to revenue; ISG growth slows but margins hold; FY28 EPS grows about 10% on the FY27 guide

bull.driver: AI orders ($60.9B booked in Q2 FY27) keep converting above the guide and the market pays a premium multiple for AI infrastructure growth

valuation.implied_by_close: At the $25.50 FY27 non-GAAP EPS guide, the 344.53 close equals 13.5x. At the base FY28 EPS of $28.00 the close equals 12.3x. The aggregate Yahoo Finance mean target of $585.68 (25 analysts) equals about 23.0x FY27 guide EPS, or FY28 EPS of about $36.60 at 16x, so the aggregate sits above the base case and is not an independent check.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $28.00 (about 8.1 pp of the 344.53 close). A $1.00 change in FY28 EPS moves the base target by $16.00 (about 4.6 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: AI-Optimized Servers revenue and non-GAAP operating margin in ISG; a sustained gross-margin decline or a sharp fall in the $95B AI backlog would weaken the base case, while FY28 guidance at or above about $28 EPS would support it.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q3 FY27 results, expected 2026-11-24 after the close (Q3 guide: revenue about $49.0B, non-GAAP EPS $6.50), and the FY28 outlook when issued.

analyst_notes: No named, dated analyst call could be verified from a primary source with a confirmed analyst name, date and pre-close public time. Aggregator pages (MarketBeat, Benzinga, Fintel, Walnut) report about 18 to 36 analysts with averages between about $502 and $585, but they conflict on dates and prices, and several list firm-only or unnamed actions (for example, a Barclays downgrade to Equal Weight on 2026-10-14 with the analyst unnamed, and a Goldman Sachs Buy with a $185 target dated 2025-11-26). Because those rows lack a verified name or date, they are excluded from the event list rather than estimated. The Yahoo Finance aggregate in data/aggregate (mean $585.68, median $600, 25 analysts) sits well above the base case, so the independent base case of $448 is about 23% below the aggregate mean of $585.68; the gap is best read as a multiple gap (about 23x FY27 guide EPS against the 16x base) rather than a verified analyst assumption.
